mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when t.status in ('2','3') then 1 else 0 end) as closedCount, sum(case when t.status in ('2','3') and t.close_time is not null and t.due_time is not null and t.close_time <= t.due_time then 1 else 0 end) as closedOnTimeCount, sum(case when t.status in ('2','3') and ( (t.due_time is not null and t.close_time is not null and t.close_time > t.due_time) or t.overtime_flag = 1 ) then 1 else 0 end) as closedOvertimeCount, sum(case when t.status in ('0','1') then 1 else 0 end) as openCount, sum(case when t.status in ('0','1') and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now() then 1 else 0 end) as openOvertimeCount, sum(case when t.status in ('0','1') and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time >= now() then 1 else 0 end) as dueSoonCount from ai_call_ticket t where t.create_time >= #{beginTime} and t.create_time < #{endTime}

select coalesce(t.external_type, 'INTERNAL') as bizType, count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when t.status in ('2','3') then 1 else 0 end) as closedCount, sum(case when t.status in ('2','3') and t.close_time is not null and t.due_time is not null and t.close_time <= t.due_time then 1 else 0 end) as onTimeCount, sum(case when t.status in ('0','1') and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time < now() then 1 else 0 end) as openOvertimeCount from ai_call_ticket t where t.create_time >= #{beginTime} and t.create_time < #{endTime} group by coalesce(t.external_type, 'INTERNAL') order by totalCount desc

select t.assign_user_id as userId, coalesce(nullif(t.assign_user_name, ''), concat('用户', t.assign_user_id)) as userName, count(1) as closedCount, sum(case when t.close_time is not null and t.due_time is not null and t.close_time <= t.due_time then 1 else 0 end) as onTimeCount, round(avg(case when t.close_time is not null and t.create_time is not null then timestampdiff(SECOND, t.create_time, t.close_time) end) / 60, 1) as avgHandleMinutes from ai_call_ticket t where t.assign_user_id is not null and t.status in ('2','3') and t.close_time is not null and t.create_time >= #{beginTime} and t.create_time < #{endTime} group by t.assign_user_id, t.assign_user_name order by closedCount desc, onTimeCount asc

select t.ticket_id as ticketId, t.ticket_no as ticketNo, t.title as title, t.priority as priority, t.status as status, coalesce(t.external_type, 'INTERNAL') as bizType, t.assign_user_name as assignUserName, t.due_time as dueTime, t.close_time as closeTime, case when t.status in ('0','1') then timestampdiff(MINUTE, t.due_time, now()) else timestampdiff(MINUTE, t.due_time, t.close_time) end as overdueMinutes from ai_call_ticket t where t.due_time is not null and ( (t.status in ('0','1') and t.due_time < now()) or (t.status in ('2','3') and t.close_time is not null and t.close_time > t.due_time) ) and t.create_time >= #{beginTime} and t.create_time < #{endTime} order by case when t.status in ('0','1') then 0 else 1 end, overdueMinutes desc limit #{limit}
select count(1) from ai_call_ticket t where t.status in ('0','1') and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time >= now() and timestampdiff(SECOND, now(), t.due_time) <= #{warnMinutes} * 60

select t.ticket_id as ticketId, t.ticket_no as ticketNo, t.title as title, t.priority as priority, coalesce(t.external_type, 'INTERNAL') as bizType, t.assign_user_name as assignUserName, t.due_time as dueTime, timestampdiff(SECOND, now(), t.due_time) as remainSeconds from ai_call_ticket t where t.status in ('0','1') and t.due_time is not null and t.due_time >= now() and timestampdiff(SECOND, now(), t.due_time) <= #{warnMinutes} * 60 order by t.due_time asc limit #{limit}

select tr.external_type as bizType, tr.direction as direction, count(1) as transferCount, sum(case when tr.external_status = 'DONE' then 1 else 0 end) as doneCount, round(avg(case when tr.external_status = 'DONE' and tr.callback_time is not null then timestampdiff(SECOND, tr.transfer_time, tr.callback_time) end) / 60, 1) as avgHandleMinutes from ai_ticket_transfer tr where tr.create_time >= #{beginTime} and tr.create_time < #{endTime} group by tr.external_type, tr.direction order by transferCount desc
